# Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a two-dimensional matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All log probability matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights for future tokens
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted averages
    weighted_avg_with = np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    weighted_avg_no_call = np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)

    # Margin improvement over not calling
    margin = weighted_avg_with - weighted_avg_no_call

    # Keep if improvement is at least tau_filter
    keep_mask = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep_mask, margin
